claims: The Artemis program is a NASA-led initiative.
The Artemis program is designed to return humans to the Moon including the first woman and person of color.
The Artemis program is designed to establish a sustainable presence on the Moon.
Artemis I occurred in 2022.
Artemis I was uncrewed.
Artemis II is planned for 2026.
Artemis II is crewed.
Artemis II is a flyby mission.
Artemis I was a successful 3-week flight test.
Artemis I tested the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft.
Artemis I orbited the Moon to verify systems.
Artemis II is a ~10-day crewed mission.
Artemis II launches four astronauts.
Artemis II performs a flyby loop around the Moon and returns to Earth.
Artemis II tests life-support systems in deep space.
Artemis III is planned for ~2027.
Artemis III is aimed at landing the first astronauts on the lunar South Pole.
The Artemis program's goal is to establish a permanent base on the Moon.
The permanent base on the Moon is a stepping stone for future human missions to Mars.
The Artemis program uses the SLS rocket.
The SLS rocket is more powerful than Saturn V.
The Artemis program uses the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis program features international collaboration.
The Artemis program involves private companies like SpaceX and Axiom Space.
SpaceX and Axiom Space provide landing systems and next-generation spacesuits for the Artemis program.
Artemis II is set to set a new human spaceflight record.
Artemis II will venture over 4,100 miles beyond the far side of the Moon.
